transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started on the planning huddle for tomorrow's field communications rehearsal. I've got the draft schedule showing a 0900 start at East Ridge, and we need to finalize a few things before I publish the binding schedule. First, we need to decide whether East Ridge or West Valley will be the location. Second, we need to name either Bravo Team or Alpha Team as the lead team for the rehearsal. And third, I need to make sure we've got both the access-control coordination action and a documented field-safety coordination action locked in before the rehearsal starts. Range control, signal, medical — let's hear your routine updates, and then we'll settle the open items.

transcript.text: Ma'am, I need to flag a critical range control issue. I confirmed at 0700 this morning that the East Ridge access road will be closed from 0800 through 1030 tomorrow for road grading. That closure rules out East Ridge entirely — if we start there at 0900, we lose an hour and a half of our four-hour window before the road even opens. I recommend we move the rehearsal to West Valley and shift the start to 0830 to preserve the full four-hour period. I'll get the closure confirmation entered on the daily range bulletin as soon as we wrap up here.

transcript.text: Ma'am, I have a critical signal issue that affects the lead team decision. I confirmed this morning that only Bravo Team has a currently qualified frequency manager for the planned net configuration. Alpha Team's qualification expired last week, and their replacement certification is still being processed. That means Bravo Team must be named as the lead team for tomorrow's rehearsal — Alpha Team is not currently qualified to run the net.
